canaries.name: false_is_zero
canaries.note: Presented as writing false as the single byte 0x00 'like every other zero'; RLP encodes false as the empty string 0x80, so every false field is encoded wrongly.

canaries.name: big_input_no_tail_check
canaries.note: Skips DecodeBytes' trailing-data check for inputs over 1 KiB ('large inputs are always single blocks'); a large encoding followed by extra bytes is now accepted instead of failing with ErrMoreThanOneValue. The tests only append trailing data to short inputs.

canaries.name: no_buffer_pool
canaries.note: Presented as removing sync.Pool overhead from EncodeToBytes; every call now allocates a fresh encBuffer and grows its slices from zero, which costs more than the pool.

candidates.name: bigint_words
candidates.note: encBuffer.writeBigInt fills the big-endian bytes of integers wider than 64 bits from i.Bits() a whole 64-bit word at a time (binary.BigEndian.PutUint64), only the most significant word byte by byte, instead of math.ReadBits' byte-at-a-time loop. 32-bit platforms keep the old path.
